newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese rail unions call strike for December 23.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese rail unions call strike for December 23.

text.p: Several Portuguese rail unions called a 24-hour strike on December 23 to protest against a planned re-organisation of the state railway system, a spokesman for the company said on Thursday.

Critically timed to coincide with the run-up to Christmas, the strike, called by the Communist-led Federation of Portuguese Railworkers Unions, would hit long-distance trains and some suburban services, he said. The walkout is due to begin at midnight (0000 GMT).

The unions, which held a similar stoppage on November 29, are angry about government plans to split the rail company, CP-Caminhos de Ferro Portugueses, into two separate concerns to boost efficiency. The Unions worry that the move will lead to lay-offs.
